apps.localizedDescription:
RR3 offline fix for iPhone SE 3:

RR3 offline - fix for iPhone SE3 fixes the 33 MB additional-data download stall in the preserved Real Racing 3 14.0.1 iOS package.

After an iOS update: stuck at 661 MB?:

Recovery guide with screenshot → Re-import the matching Caches_ipastore.zip using the blue folder icon → first green row, 导入数据包 (Import data package), then fully close and reopen the game. The owner confirmed this fixed the 661 MB stall after updating to iOS 26.7.1. No new IPA, Sideloadly installation or Python was needed. The existing HD patch was still active in the diagnostic log.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Open it in Sideloadly, connect your iPhone SE 3, select your Apple ID and click Start. Leave additional tweak injection off.
• Keep your imported cache. For a fresh installation, import Caches_ipastore.zip through the game's three-finger double-tap menu.

Updating? Back up your data, leave the existing app installed, and use the same Apple ID and bundle-ID setting.

Simple installation guide.

Verified file:

This is the exact HD v1 IPA the owner reported working on iPhone SE 3 / iOS 26.6.1: launch, a race, and an offline cold restart. It includes the local diagnostic logger. Other devices and all optional events have not been validated.
